title: Guidelines for Evidence Collection and Archiving
action_definition_and_granularity: Collection is an ordered and documented procedure over identified systems; no mathematical atomic action is defined.
cost_construct_and_units: Volatility is an ordering or urgency property; integrity and external avenues for change are procedural constraints. No numeric acquisition-cost scale is defined.
assignment_or_measurement_method: Site-specific procedures; collect from more volatile to less volatile sources; document every step.
additivity_context_and_uncertainty: No additive cost claim and no scalarization. Evidence disturbance is something to prevent, not a commensurate price.
validation_or_governance: Methods should be transparent, precisely reproducible, and testable by independent experts; use checksums or signatures where feasible.
project05_supports: Use volatility as delay loss, deadline, or priority; require reproducible action execution and audit records.
does_not_support: Does not justify V as positive burden; does not justify E+D+A+R+V or a 0-3 rubric.

title: Guide to Integrating Forensic Techniques into Incident Response
action_definition_and_granularity: Collection comprises identifying, labeling, recording, and acquiring data while preserving integrity; the collection plan identifies sources and order.
cost_construct_and_units: Three distinct prioritization factors are likely value, volatility, and amount of effort. Effort includes staff and legal-advisor time, equipment, services, and outside experts. Operational disruption and monetary loss are separate.
assignment_or_measurement_method: Analyst or management estimates relative value and effort for the incident; organizational time, equipment, and service facts can be measured.
additivity_context_and_uncertainty: No formula says the factors are additive or equally weighted. Downtime impact is separate from acquisition effort.
validation_or_governance: Identify sources, plan, acquire, and verify integrity under organization-specific policies and legal review.
project05_supports: Separate utility, delay loss, burden, and operational impact; ground burden in measurable human time, equipment, and services.
does_not_support: Does not provide universal numbers, E/D/A/R anchors, or an equal-weight scalar; volatility is not a resource consumed.

title: Incident Response Recommendations and Considerations for Cybersecurity Risk Management: A CSF 2.0 Community Profile
action_definition_and_granularity: Governs incident-response activities at organizational and process level rather than atomic planner actions.
cost_construct_and_units: Uses enterprise risk, incident impact, efficiency/effectiveness, retention cost, and disruption as distinct management concerns.
assignment_or_measurement_method: Organization-specific risk management, retention policy, and incident analysis.
additivity_context_and_uncertainty: No universal additive action cost and no per-action numeric scale.
validation_or_governance: Integrates response with CSF 2.0 governance and organizational risk management.
project05_supports: Treat operational impact and retention burden as contextual governance quantities.
does_not_support: Does not define acquisition-action costs or validate an ordinal rubric.

title: ISO/IEC 27037:2012 Guidelines for identification collection acquisition and preservation of digital evidence
action_definition_and_granularity: Names identification, collection, acquisition, and preservation as distinct activities.
cost_construct_and_units: No numeric cost construct appears in the official public scope.
assignment_or_measurement_method: Process guidance is adapted to devices, circumstances, organizations, and jurisdictions.
additivity_context_and_uncertainty: No public claim of additive or state-independent cost.
validation_or_governance: Supports disciplined evidence handling and cross-jurisdiction exchange.
project05_supports: Use a controlled action taxonomy aligned with recognized forensic activities.
does_not_support: Does not support a numeric cost table, weights, or action-count metric.

title: ISO/IEC 27043:2015 Incident investigation principles and processes
action_definition_and_granularity: Covers processes from pre-incident preparation through investigation closure; granularity is process-level.
cost_construct_and_units: No numeric per-action cost appears in the official public scope.
assignment_or_measurement_method: Uses idealized process models plus scenario-specific advice and caveats.
additivity_context_and_uncertainty: No scalar cost or additivity claim on the public page.
validation_or_governance: General principles apply across several digital-investigation scenarios.
project05_supports: Require action semantics to fit an auditable end-to-end investigation process.
does_not_support: Does not define atomic actions, resource units, or universal costs.

title: ISO/IEC/IEEE 15939:2017 Systems and software engineering Measurement process
action_definition_and_granularity: No domain action definition; it governs specification and use of measures.
cost_construct_and_units: Measures address specific information needs; no universal cost measure is prescribed.
assignment_or_measurement_method: Specify required information, how measures and results will be used, and how validity will be determined; tailor to users.
additivity_context_and_uncertainty: No permission to combine incommensurate units without an analysis model.
validation_or_governance: Requires determining whether analysis results are valid.
project05_supports: Derive measures from declared decision needs and validate the analysis model before planner use.
does_not_support: Does not validate a score merely because two raters agree.

title: PDDL2.1: An Extension to PDDL for Expressing Temporal Planning Domains
action_definition_and_granularity: Actions have parameters, preconditions, and effects; durative actions add start/end conditions, invariants, and timed effects.
cost_construct_and_units: Numeric fluents and plan metrics can represent resource consumption, energy, duration, or other quantities; metric is not action count.
assignment_or_measurement_method: Domain modeler specifies measurable fluents and the problem metric.
additivity_context_and_uncertainty: Aggregation follows declared transitions and metrics; concurrency and duration require explicit semantics.
validation_or_governance: Formal syntax and state-transition semantics make applicability and effects auditable.
project05_supports: Freeze preconditions, effects, timing, and metric separately for every acquisition action.
does_not_support: Does not supply cybersecurity action boundaries or numeric acquisition costs.
verified_location: Local PDF pp. 2-5, 11 and formal semantics

title: The LAMA Planner: Guiding Cost-Based Anytime Planning with Landmarks
action_definition_and_granularity: Operator o=<pre,effect> is applicable when preconditions hold; C maps operators to nonnegative integer costs.
cost_construct_and_units: Plan cost is the sum of supplied operator costs; unit-cost and nonuniform-cost tasks are distinguished.
assignment_or_measurement_method: Benchmark or domain author supplies costs in PDDL; planner optimizes the given values.
additivity_context_and_uncertainty: Additivity is a benchmark assumption. Cost-sensitive search can reduce task coverage under a time limit.
validation_or_governance: Empirical ablations compare cost-sensitive and distance-sensitive search on IPC tasks.
project05_supports: Shows planners consume exogenous costs and action count can differ from total cost.
does_not_support: Does not establish how real forensic costs should be assigned or that additive integers are universal.

title: Planning Algorithms
action_definition_and_granularity: At state x an available choice u is in U(x), and x'=f(x,u) defines transition; a lower-level plan can be packaged as a higher-level action.
cost_construct_and_units: A cost functional accumulates stage costs l(x,u) and terminal cost; examples include distance, time, and energy.
assignment_or_measurement_method: Modeler defines state, feasible action set, transition, stage cost, horizon, and terminal cost.
additivity_context_and_uncertainty: Finite-horizon sum is one model; hierarchical packaging makes action count granularity-dependent.
validation_or_governance: Formal feasibility and cost-to-go equations expose assumptions.
project05_supports: Define actions by feasible state, invocation, transition, termination, and resource trace; test split/merge granularity.
does_not_support: Does not define a canonical forensic action unit or resource weights.

title: Reinforcement Learning: An Introduction (2nd ed.)
action_definition_and_granularity: At each decision time the agent selects A_t from A(S_t), then receives R_{t+1} and S_{t+1}; an option is a policy plus termination and can span many base steps.
cost_construct_and_units: Reward can be r(s,a) or r(s,a,s'); cost is negative reward only after semantics and scale are defined.
assignment_or_measurement_method: Environment or model determines transitions and rewards; options execute low-level actions until termination.
additivity_context_and_uncertainty: Return uses declared horizon or discount. One option can replace many primitive actions, so action count is representation-dependent.
validation_or_governance: Policy evaluation uses observed or modeled transitions and returns.
project05_supports: Require decision epoch and termination; report high-level acquisitions and primitive operations or resource-normalized metrics.
does_not_support: Does not make primitive-action count comparable to option count and does not assign domain costs.

title: Types of Cost in Inductive Concept Learning
action_definition_and_granularity: A test or attribute measurement is an acquisition choice used before classification.
cost_construct_and_units: Cost may use dollars, seconds, CPU time, or utility and may be uncertain; test cost can depend on prior tests, results, class, case, and time.
assignment_or_measurement_method: Use application facts or distributions; this is a taxonomy, not a universal assignment table.
additivity_context_and_uncertainty: Grouped tests may share setup cost and cost less than their sum; context dependence violates fixed c(a).
validation_or_governance: Explicitly distinguishes cost types and uncertainty.
project05_supports: Use c(s,a) or c(s,a,s'), include setup, shared, and retry costs, and preserve physical units before scalarization.
does_not_support: Does not authorize equal-weight ordinal scores for unlike units.

title: Sequential Cost-Sensitive Feature Acquisition
action_definition_and_granularity: A stochastic policy adaptively acquires feature blocks from a partially observed sample and can classify or stop.
cost_construct_and_units: Inference cost sums supplied feature costs; experiments use cost=1, artificial c_i=i/n, or literature-provided medical costs.
assignment_or_measurement_method: Costs are external dataset inputs; real CPU and energy budgets are future work.
additivity_context_and_uncertainty: Additive feature cost is explicit; shared setup cost is not modeled.
validation_or_governance: Accuracy-cost curves and held-out tests validate performance conditional on supplied costs.
project05_supports: AFA answers how to plan after costs are given, not how authoritative costs are built.
does_not_support: Artificial c_i=i/n and unit costs cannot validate Project05 real costs.

action_definition_and_granularity: The bibliographic record indicates sequential active classification with acquisition and misclassification trade-offs; formal action semantics were not extracted.
cost_construct_and_units: Cost-sensitive objective; units and assignment method remain unverified without full text.
assignment_or_measurement_method: Not extracted from primary full text.

action_definition_and_granularity: Bibliographic record and secondary references identify a POMDP-style acquisition/classification problem; formal details were not extracted from primary text.
cost_construct_and_units: Feature-acquisition and classification-error costs; units and elicitation remain unverified.
assignment_or_measurement_method: Not extracted from primary full text.
additivity_context_and_uncertainty: Not extracted.

title: Bayesian Experimental Design: A Review
action_definition_and_granularity: A design is a decision about what experiment or observation to perform for a stated purpose.
cost_construct_and_units: Utility represents experiment purpose and consequences; designs may be optimized under total or observation-specific costs.
assignment_or_measurement_method: Decision maker specifies purpose, probability model, utility, and cost constraint.
additivity_context_and_uncertainty: No universal utility or exchange rate; utility depends on purpose.
validation_or_governance: Bayesian expected-utility analysis evaluates candidate designs under the declared model.
project05_supports: Keep information value separate from resource cost and declare decision purpose before scalarization.
does_not_support: Does not define forensic costs or justify equal weighting of resources.
verified_location: Local scanned PDF; visually checked design-utility sections

title: Information Value Theory
action_definition_and_granularity: Information acquisition is evaluated as a decision that can change later choices; exact formal text was not locally verified.
cost_construct_and_units: Value of information is a consequence or utility construct rather than physical acquisition burden.
assignment_or_measurement_method: Probability and preference inputs are indicated by the literature lineage; exact formulation is pending full text.

title: Constrained Markov Decision Processes
action_definition_and_granularity: Defines states X, actions A(x), transition probabilities, immediate objective cost c(x,a), and K-dimensional immediate constraint costs d(x,a).
cost_construct_and_units: The problem minimizes expected C(beta,u) subject to vector constraints D(beta,u)<=V; discounted, total, and average criteria are distinct.
assignment_or_measurement_method: Modeler supplies c, d, thresholds V, transition model, initial distribution, and horizon or discount assumptions.
additivity_context_and_uncertainty: Costs are state-action dependent; accumulation follows the criterion. Constraints are not weighted objectives unless an explicit Lagrangian is introduced.
validation_or_governance: Feasibility, occupation measures, LPs, and policy classes are defined under explicit assumptions.
project05_supports: Represent authorization, hard risk limits, and budgets as constraints when not exchangeable; distinguish burden from constraint dimensions.
does_not_support: Does not supply domain c, d, or V and does not justify arbitrary Lagrange weights.
verified_location: INRIA author PDF pp. 21-24, 29, 31-32; accessed in memory

title: A Survey of Multi-Objective Sequential Decision-Making
action_definition_and_granularity: MOMDP retains vector-valued returns and policies over state-dependent actions.
cost_construct_and_units: Objectives remain a vector; scalarization f(V,w) and weight vector w encode preferences. Constraints are a distinct variant.
assignment_or_measurement_method: Weights and scalarization come from the decision scenario; when unknown, compute coverage or Pareto-relevant sets.
additivity_context_and_uncertainty: Linear weighted sum is one special case; nonlinear and unknown-weight settings require different solution concepts.
validation_or_governance: Taxonomy specifies weight knowledge, scalarization class, policy class, coverage sets, and Pareto dominance.
project05_supports: Keep resource dimensions separate; report Pareto or coverage results until defensible weights exist; sensitivity-test chosen weights.
does_not_support: Does not prescribe equal weights or make Pareto optimality select one universal policy.

title: Access Path Selection in a Relational Database Management System
action_definition_and_granularity: A query plan is composed of access paths and joins; alternatives are compared by predicted resource use.
cost_construct_and_units: COST = page fetches + W*RSI calls; page fetches proxy I/O and RSI calls proxy CPU or tuple processing.
assignment_or_measurement_method: Predict counts from statistics; W is an adjustable I/O-versus-CPU weight.
additivity_context_and_uncertainty: Additivity and linear weighting are explicit engineering assumptions tied to System R.
validation_or_governance: Plans are compared using operational statistics and adjustable calibration.
project05_supports: Measure raw bytes, records, I/O, and CPU first; publish weights and calibrate against executions.
does_not_support: System R W and proxies are not portable constants and do not validate subjective ordinal costs.

title: How Good Are Query Optimizers Really?
action_definition_and_granularity: Query-plan alternatives are evaluated by a predictive operator cost model rather than semantic action count.
cost_construct_and_units: PostgreSQL cost is a weighted sum of accessed pages and memory-processed data or CPU proxies; plan cost sums operators.
assignment_or_measurement_method: Default parameters are designer choices; tune with observed runtime and workload experiments.
additivity_context_and_uncertainty: Linear additive structure is tested rather than universal; prediction error is measured against runtime.
validation_or_governance: Defines absolute percentage prediction error and reports workload-specific tuning results.
project05_supports: Validate Project05 predictions against execution traces and report error and calibration, not only rater agreement.
does_not_support: Does not imply generalization across hardware or workload, or that predicted cost equals real time.

title: Sampling-based Algorithms for Optimal Motion Planning
action_definition_and_granularity: A feasible path is a continuous bounded-variation trajectory; the optimization unit can be an entire path.
cost_construct_and_units: A supplied path functional may represent path length or execution time and maps paths to nonnegative values.
assignment_or_measurement_method: Problem designer defines the task-appropriate functional.
additivity_context_and_uncertainty: Presentation sometimes assumes additive segment cost for simplicity; the analysis states this is not always necessary.
validation_or_governance: Asymptotic optimality is proved relative to the specified functional and assumptions.
project05_supports: Treat time, distance or bytes, energy or compute, and risk as different functionals; declare additivity.
does_not_support: Does not define universal action cost or make path length interchangeable with execution time.

validation_or_governance: Systematic search and classification report metrics and methods used.
project05_supports: Cross-domain example of directly measured execution time with value kept separate.
